# Madduck Hospital Environment

Source: https://madduck.itch.io/modular-3d-hospital-environment

Imported files:
- `FBX/` contains the Unity-facing model files.
- `Hospital_assets/textures/` contains the PBR texture set used by the scene builder.
- `Hospital_assets/UE5_textures/` is kept for reference, but the Unity scene builder does not use it.

License notes from the source page:
- Use is allowed in commercial and non-commercial projects.
- Modifying the assets is allowed.
- Credit is not required, but keeping this source note is recommended.
- Do not redistribute or resell the asset pack as standalone game assets.

Unity setup:
- Menu: `Tools > CPR > 0.7 > Build Madduck Hospital Room In Current Scene`
- Menu: `Tools > CPR > 0.7 > Open 0.7 And Build Madduck Hospital Room`
